name: Ball Sprinter 3D: Night Shift Trial
author: Alex4791
description: Welcome to the trial version of Ball Sprinter 3D on Night Mode. In this early release, you'll explore the environments of a few early levels and ways to navigate to the finishing point on each one. The story centers itself in a night environment consisting primarily of dark and morose themes in contrast to bright and vibrant ones. The stars have apparently fallen from the sky but thankfully enough is there a completion star around every corner to indicate you have finished every level. The full version of this game will release soon in 2020.
